capabilities: generate vector embeddings for notes via Ollama or OpenAI
visualize content similarity as dotted edges in a graph
combine wikilinks and semantic similarity in one view
tune physics, thresholds, and display options per graph
track and update embeddings only for changed files
extras: Manual installation only (clone into .obsidian/plugins); the README notes the plugin is not yet listed in the official community plugin directory.
intentEvidence: Unlike the standard graph view which only shows explicit links
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view only shows explicitly linked notes, so content-related notes that are not linked to each other stay invisible.

relations.evidence: You can choose between Ollama (local, free) or OpenAI (cloud, paid).
Select OpenAI (API key required) as the embedding provider
Powered by D3.js, featuring a responsive force-directed layout you can tweak in real-time.

summary: Semantic graph view that draws dotted similarity edges between notes using vector embeddings generated locally with Ollama or via OpenAI.
